postStartCommand.opencode: opencode service set hostname 0.0.0.0 && opencode service set port 4096 && opencode service set env OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT "" && opencode service start
postStartCommand.effect-reference: tag='effect@4.0.0-rc.115'; path='references/effect'; mkdir -p references && if [ ! -d $path/.git ]; then git clone --branch $tag --single-branch https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect $path; else git -C $path fetch origin tag $tag && git -C $path switch --detach $tag; fi
